title: festuca cinerea subsp. caesia
intro: Festuca cinerea subsp. caesia, commonly known as mountain hair grass, is a species of grass native to the mountains of Europe and Asia. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of mountain hair grass are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exert antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Festuca cinerea subsp. caesia include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
